🔴 **A deploy failed**
**Impact:** This push is not (fully) applied. The server usually keeps running with what it had; if the deploy failed while restarting it or in the smoke test, players may not be able to join.
**Likely cause:** A step of the deploy job failed (the run says which: the client pack mirror, the tailnet, Ansible, or the smoke test from the internet).
**What to do:** Open the run: https://github.com/example-owner/example-config/actions/runs/123 . Fix the cause, then push again or re-run the deploy (Actions, server, Run workflow, deploy); `mcctl doctor` checks credentials and reachability.
**Details:** deploy job failed
